directive.verbatim: ok use codex to create a visual series with image generator for a character to mint every day in december on say tezos. make them very almost regal ralph lauren, dogs, one assigned to every day in september
directive.interpretation: Thirty-one dog portrait sittings, one assigned to each day of December 2026, generated by Codex through poster-image-engine and minted one per day on Tezos. The directive names both December and September; December is the mint calendar here because it was stated as the mint month and it covers 31 days. Switching to a 30-day month means dropping Sitting 31 and changing mintDate values only.
directive.characterAuthorship: Dog names, titles, wardrobes, and scenes are cc editorial inventions under the directive, not Mike's words.

visualSystem.register: Heritage American-Anglo equestrian and Ivy menswear worn by dogs, painted like nineteenth-century society portraits. Regal, warm, slightly amused. The reference mood is old-money country estate in December, described in materials and settings rather than by any brand name.
visualSystem.styleBase: Formal painted portrait of a single dog, rendered like a nineteenth-century society oil painting with visible brushwork and varnish depth. The dog is dressed in a heritage equestrian and Ivy menswear register: tweed, tartan, cable knit, camel hair, navy wool, oxblood leather, brass hardware. Old-money country-estate setting, dark wood, aged brass, warm lamplight, winter light at the windows. Dignified posture, slightly amused expression, eyes on the viewer. Anatomically correct dog with a natural coat; clothing sits on the body plausibly. Muted rich palette: hunter green, oxblood, camel, navy, cream, mahogany.
visualSystem.antiPrompt: No text, no lettering, no logos, no monograms, no brand marks, no humans, no hands, no cartoon styling, no neon, no glossy plastic 3D render, no AI sparkle, no watermark, no frame border.
visualSystem.compositionRule: Ikebana balance: asymmetrical, subject on one two-thirds side alternating by day parity, negative space on the other third, one focal point. Never dead-center.

output.model: gpt-image-1 or newest available image model

visualSystem.boundaries: Original portraits only. No brand names, logos, monograms, crests, or trademarked patterns in prompts or outputs. No humans. Breeds are described generically. Wardrobe is described by material and cut.

mint.proposedContract: contracts/v2/kennel_club_fa2.py (dedicated FA2, 31 token ids, mirrors coffee_mugs pattern)
mint.cadence: one token id opens per calendar day, America/Los_Angeles
mint.editionModel: waiting-on-mh: 24-hour open edition per sitting, or fixed cap per sitting (proposed 31)

The dog is dressed in a heritage equestrian and Ivy menswear register: tweed, tartan, cable knit, camel hair, navy wool, oxblood leather, brass hardware. Old-money country-estate setting, dark wood, aged brass, warm lamplight, winter light at the windows. Dignified posture, slightly amused expression, eyes on the viewer. Anatomically correct dog with a natural coat; clothing sits on the body plausibly. Muted rich palette: hunter green, oxblood, camel, navy, cream, mahogany. Subject: a English Springer Spaniel with a liver and white coat, wearing a cream cable-knit sweater with a tortoiseshell hair clip on one ear. Scene: seated at a small writing desk by a window, a stack of letters, a fountain pen, sealing wax and a brass letter opener. Asymmetrical composition: the dog occupies the right two-thirds, quiet negative space on the left third, single focal point, shallow painterly depth. No text, no lettering, no logos, no monograms, no brand marks, no humans, no hands, no cartoon styling, no neon, no glossy plastic 3D render, no AI sparkle, no watermark, no frame border.
